# magpie-gemini-web [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/magpie-gemini-web?style=flat-square&logo=npm&color=4f46e5)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-gemini-web) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/magpie-gemini-web?style=flat-square&color=06b6d4)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-gemini-web) [![Magpie Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Magpie-Plugin-3b82f6?style=flat-square)](https://usemagpie.ai/) [![Node.js >= 22](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-8b5cf6?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Windows-6366f1?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-10b981?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [中文](README.md) | English Use **Google AI Studio** and **Gemini on the web** through your Google account in [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai/). The plugin runs [AIStudio2API](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API) and [gemini-web2api-go](https://github.com/zexadev/gemini-web2api-go) locally, providing chat, native function calling, Nano Banana image generation, and Deep Research through OpenAI-compatible and Gemini APIs. > **New model support:** Both providers now list **`gemini-4-hydrogen`** and **`gemini-4-carbon`**. AI Studio follows official stable backend releases and maps Hydrogen's `xhigh` thinking tier. Gemini Web's one-click local backend exposes dedicated model IDs starting with **`4.30.0-magpie.1`**: Hydrogen works with signed-in accounts (including free accounts), Carbon requires an eligible paid/Ultra account, and the legacy `gemini-4-argon` name remains a Carbon alias. ## Which Provider Should I Choose? The plugin provides two independent providers that can be used individually or together: | Feature | Google AI Studio (`ai-studio`) | Gemini Web (`gemini-web`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Best for** | **Primary use & coding agents (recommended)** | General chat & web quota | | **Key models** | `gemini-4-carbon` (Ultra / eligible accounts), `gemini-4-hydrogen`, `gemini-4-argon`, `gemini-3.1-pro`, Flash series, Deep Research | `gemini-4-hydrogen` (signed-in, including free accounts), `gemini-4-carbon` (paid/Ultra), `gemini-3.6-flash`, `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` | | **Tool calling** | **Native Function Calling**, reliable | Prompt-emulated (experimental; Flash often skips tools) | | **Thinking levels** | Supported levels from the model catalog: `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` (Hydrogen) | `low` (base) / `medium` (`-thinking-medium`, `gemini-4-argon` only) / `high` (`-thinking` extended thinking) | | **Image input** | On by default; chat models read images | On by default; chat models read images (needs a signed-in cookie) | | **Image generation** | Nano Banana models, for Magpie's image generation (Magpie v0.1.2075+, see below) | Not supported | | **Sign-in method** | Automatic official installation; confirm an imported account | Copy `cookie` from a private/incognito window | | **Usage cards** | Shows models currently on cooldown and recovery times | Syncs **5-hour** & **weekly** usage and reset times from the web | | **Local backend** | AIStudio2API (automatic installation and stable updates) | gemini-web2api-go (`4.30.0-magpie.1` optimized build) | --- ## Quick Start Install **magpie-gemini-web** from the Magpie plugin market, then sign in to either (or both) providers below. By default, the plugin downloads the backend, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and runs it in the background, with no Go installation required. AI Studio automatically follows official stable releases by default. You can disable automatic updates, select your own executable or connect an independent service. ### Option 1: Google AI Studio (`ai-studio`) 1. Sign in to **Google AI Studio** in Magpie and choose **「添加账号并连接（推荐）」** (Add an account and connect). 2. On first use, the plugin **automatically downloads, verifies and starts the latest stable official AIStudio2API backend**. No manual download, executable path, API key copying or administrator credentials are needed. 3. Click **「打开账号管理页」** (Open account management) on the connection page, then add a Google account using Chrome import, cookie import or browser login. 4. Return to the connection page, select the account and click **「连接到 Magpie」** (Connect to Magpie). The existing `ai-studio` provider, models, image generation and usage cards remain available. Repeat sign-in to add more accounts. If an existing account needs to sign in again, select that account in Magpie, use its **Re-login** action in account management, then return to confirm the connection. Subsequent starts reuse the installed executable. **Automatic stable updates are enabled by default:** while Magpie is running, the plugin checks in the background, caching successful release checks for an hour. After downloading and verifying an update, it waits for generation requests (including streams), account login and browser preparation to finish before upgrading and restarting. Accounts, port, credentials and settings remain in place; no new plugin release is needed. Failed checks or downloads leave the current version running. A failed new executable triggers an attempted rollback and blocks repeated attempts to install that archive. Use `npm run studio:updates -- manual` to manage versions yourself, or `npm run studio:updates -- auto` to resume automatic updates. Custom executables and independent services remain user-managed. Browser login downloads Camoufox (about 1.3 GB with v0.3.7+); Chrome / cookie import can use existing sessions. In Docker containers or headless remote servers where `127.0.0.1` pages are unreachable from your desktop browser, choose **「通过粘贴 Cookie 登录（无头 / 远程环境适用）」** (automatically promoted to first option as **「粘贴 Cookie 无头登录（Docker / 远程服务器推荐）」** inside containers): copy the `cookie` header from an `aistudio.google.com` request in your local browser DevTools Network tab (or Cookie-Editor JSON / Netscape `cookies.txt`) and paste it into Magpie for headless verification—no `127.0.0.1` web UI and no 1.3 GB Camoufox download required. Magpie limits each connection attempt to 10 minutes. On slow connections, finish preparation in the official account management page: its background download and login tasks continue after Magpie times out. Then start a new connection in Magpie and select the imported account. Alternatively, run `npm run studio:prepare-browser` from the plugin directory before signing in. It waits up to an hour; closing the command does not cancel the backend download. Set `studio.proxy` or `AI_STUDIO_PROXY` if GitHub is unreachable. **「直接打开 Google 登录窗口」** still opens an isolated browser login window. Existing backends with Magpie task correlation can still complete the account connection automatically. Automatic installation supports macOS / Linux x64 and arm64, and Windows x64. macOS / Linux use official CLI archives. The official Windows archive contains a desktop executable, installed beside `.env` and `runtime/` in the data directory to retain its settings. Windows arm64 currently needs a compatible executable selected through the advanced path option (for example, an x64 executable supported by the system), or an independent backend. Unsupported targets receive guidance before a release lookup. **Existing installations and version selection:** - Accounts, port, credentials and Magpie cards are preserved. The plugin can also automatically replace an older `-magpie` build in the default directory with a newer official stable release. Its compiled updater restriction does not prevent this. Automatic replacement is deferred if an older backend lacks the APIs needed to confirm idle status. To switch immediately, quit Magpie, run these commands from the plugin directory, then reopen Magpie: ```bash npm run studio:stop npm run studio:install # Current official stable release npm run studio:start ``` - To choose an official version, stop the service and run `npm run studio:install -- --version v0.3.7`. This verifies the official SHA-256 and selects manual updates to preserve your choice. Run `npm run studio:updates -- auto` to follow stable releases again. Historical installation hashes do not force file restoration, and automatic updates never downgrade a newer running version. Back up the entire data directory before downgrading: older versions may not read data migrated by newer ones. - **Advanced option:** Select 「指定 AIStudio2API 程序路径（高级）」 (Specify executable path) or run `npm run studio:use -- "/absolute/path/to/aistudio2api"`. Use an executable extracted from an [official archive](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API/releases), outside the plugin and AI Studio data directories; stop the old service before switching. A missing custom executable produces an error and is never replaced by a download. `studio:use-default` returns to the default directory, reusing its executable or installing the official CLI if absent. - Existing configurations receive a one-time migration of missing legacy defaults: `SEARCH_MODEL_ALIASES=false`, per-account concurrency / warm worker limit / maximum workers / warm startup concurrency all `1`, `ROUTING_STRATEGY=fill-first`, and `REQUEST_TIMEOUT=30m`, along with the earlier disabled hedging policy. Explicit settings and unknown keys remain intact. Later admin choices, including defaults omitted by upstream Save, are not seeded again. - Fresh installations follow upstream defaults. With v0.3.7+ this enables search model aliases, per-account concurrency 2, 10 warm / 20 maximum workers, round-robin routing, and SpiderMonkey generation. A future version changing the `WAA_BACKEND` default could also require Camoufox or other browser components for generation; choose explicit settings in the admin page if needed. - The plugin maintains the local connection and account access. Other settings belong to the backend, including future configuration keys. Uninstall or `studio:clean` removes downloaded programs from the default directory while retaining accounts and settings. With a custom path, the process, executable and entire data directory are preserved; use `studio:stop` to stop it. For an independently running service, choose **Connect an existing AIStudio2API (URL + API key)**. With official v0.3.7+, Hydrogen Extra High maps to Magpie's `xhigh` variant. ### Option 2: Gemini Web (`gemini-web`) 1. Sign in to **Gemini Web** in Magpie and choose **「一键配置本地 Gemini Web（推荐）」** (One-click local setup). If you need a proxy to reach Google, enter its URL (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7890`) when prompted at the start of sign-in, or leave it blank for direct connection / existing proxy pool. 2. Enter the **Google account index** when prompted: for `/u/4/app` in the same window you copy cookies from, enter `4`; leave it blank for a single-account session (`0`). Private windows may assign different indices from your regular browser. Copy your cookie using a **private / incognito window** (Firefox recommended): 1. Open in the private window and sign in to your Google account. 2. Press `F12` (`⌥⌘I` on macOS), switch to the **Network** tab, and reload the page. 3. Click any `gemini.google.com` request → **Headers** → **Request Headers**, copy the `cookie` value, and paste it into Magpie. 4. **Close the private window directly—do not sign out** (signing out invalidates the cookie). 3. The plugin verifies the account and completes sign-in. Repeat the steps above to add more accounts. > **Backend upgrade required during sign-in?** An older background process may still be running. Exit Magpie, stop the matching `gemini-web2api-go` process (Windows: Task Manager → Details → `gemini-web2api-go.exe`), then run the full installation command shown in the error. It preserves accounts and configuration and selects the plugin's managed backend. Set `GEMINI_WEB_PROXY` first if the download needs a proxy. Reopen Magpie and sign in after installation. > **Why is a private window required?** The backend periodically refreshes this session to keep it alive. If it shares a session with your daily browser, Google will revoke the session and sign your browser out of all Google services. A private window (or a dedicated secondary Google account) gives the backend an isolated session. --- ## Multiple Accounts & Usage Cards - **Account usage cards:** Individual accounts use their email address. An AI Studio batch gets a separate group card; importing the same group in a different order keeps its identity. - *Migrating older Gemini Web accounts:* For accounts added in earlier versions, add a Gemini Web account in Magpie and choose **「添加本地后端里已有的 Google 账号」** (Add an existing Google account from the local backend) to create individual cards, then remove the old pooled `API key …` card. - **Automatic account rotation:** The local backend selects which Google account serves each request (Gemini Web rotates across the pool; AI Studio uses one account until cooldown and switches to the next, with optional account priority order and per-model account bindings configurable in the admin page or via `studio.accountOrder` and `studio.modelAccounts`). Switching cards in Magpie does not change which account the backend picks. - **Usage reporting:** - `gemini-web`: Available only with the one-click local backend. Usage is read from Google again whenever Magpie asks for it (at most once every 30 seconds per account), so pressing refresh shows the current allowance, including usage from the Gemini app, the website or other devices. On its own, Magpie asks about once a minute while the Usage page or the menu bar's allowances panel is open, whenever it updates allowances shown in the menu bar (every 3 minutes by default), and at most once a minute while it routes requests among accounts; otherwise it doesn't ask. A failed read isn't retried on its own for 10 minutes; pressing refresh in that time retries it at once (press it again if the first press doesn't). - `ai-studio`: AI Studio does not report remaining total quota; cards display models currently on cooldown and their recovery times, or prompt when re-authentication is needed. Cards also show today's tokens and estimated USD at API list prices from the local backend's request ledger, filtered to that account or imported group. Today starts at midnight in the Magpie host's timezone. These are estimates for traffic through this backend, not actual charges or remaining credits. The backend handles model pricing, cached input and long-context tiers; unpriced models are marked as missing or partial pricing. If the backend cannot provide this report, the daily row is omitted. When the backend's `/v1/models` supplies `estimated_cost`, the plugin passes the same input, output, cached-input and context-tier rates to Magpie. Magpie hosts advertising `magpie.capabilities.modelCost: 1` use those backend rates on the Usage page, with user-set prices taking precedence. Older Magpie hosts, OpenCode, and backends without that field keep their existing catalog pricing. Account cards cover the backend's traffic; Usage covers requests recorded by Magpie, so token costs can be compared for the same requests. --- ## Image Generation (AI Studio) `ai-studio` lists the Nano Banana image models your account can use (such as `gemini-3.1-flash-image` and `gemini-3-pro-image`), for Magpie's image generation. **This needs Magpie v0.1.2075 or later**, the first to take a plugin's Gemini image models as models that draw. **Drawing from an agent** (pi, Claude Code, Codex and the rest alike): 1. **Pick the model to draw with:** Magpie's Settings list these models under **Images → Image generation**. It calls the `generate_image` tool, which draws with the model from step 1 and saves the image in the project's `generated-images/` folder; reference images make it an edit. - **Don't pick an image model as the chat model:** Magpie still keeps a plugin's models that draw in its chat model lists ([yetone/magpie#2792](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/2792)). Picked there, they show no picture: an agent such as pi has no place for an image in the model's reply, so the image the model draws is dropped, while the model believes it was shown. They take no tool calls either, and have 32K–128K context windows. - **Drawing from the command line:** `magpie tool generate_image "a magpie on a branch, watercolour" --size 16:9 -o magpie.png`; add `--model ai-studio/gemini-3-pro-image` to draw with another model this once. If the terminal can't find the `magpie` command (step 2's command too), click **Add to PATH** on the **Command line** row of Magpie's Settings, then open a new terminal. - **Size:** `size` gives the aspect ratio. A ratio (such as `16:9` or `1:4`) is used as it is when the model takes it, else the nearest one it does; a size such as `1536x1024` is made the nearest usual ratio by Magpie first. `quality` makes no difference for these models. - If you don't want the image models, turn them off with `studio.imageModels` (see the options below). --- ## Configuration & Advanced Usage

Opening `127.0.0.1` in your desktop browser reaches your own machine rather than the container unless you forward ports over SSH or Docker port mapping. 2. **Use headless cookie paste sign-in instead:** - **Google AI Studio (`ai-studio`)**: When running inside a container, the plugin automatically promotes **「粘贴 Cookie 无头登录（Docker / 远程服务器推荐）」** to the top of the sign-in list. Open in your local browser, copy the full `cookie` request header from DevTools Network (or a Cookie-Editor JSON / Netscape `cookies.txt` export), and paste it directly into Magpie—**no `127.0.0.1` browser UI and no 1.3 GB Camoufox download needed**. - **Gemini Web (`gemini-web`)**: Already signs in via pasted cookies without needing any `127.0.0.1` UI. - **CLI import (optional)**: You can also import cookies inside the container via `printf '%s' "$COOKIE" | node scripts/studio.mjs import-cookie - --proxy http://host.docker.internal:7890`. 3. **Proxy addresses inside Docker:** Inside a bridge-network container, `127.0.0.1` points to the container itself, not the host machine's proxy: - Docker Desktop (macOS / Windows): use `http://host.docker.internal:` (or `socks5://host.docker.internal:`). - Linux Docker: use `http://host.docker.internal:` with `--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway` (`extra_hosts: ["host.docker.internal:host-gateway"]` in Compose), your host's LAN IP, or `--network host`. 4. **Persistent volumes & zombie reaping:** - Mount persistent storage for `AI_STUDIO_DATA_DIR` and `GEMINI_WEB_DATA_DIR` so accounts and `.env` settings survive container recreations. - Run Docker with `--init` (`init: true` in Compose) and update to plugin `0.14.1`+ so exited child processes inside PID 1 containers never remain as zombie processes blocking health checks. --- ## License MIT. # Backend releases

The plugin's default backend is built from the upstream commit and toolchain recorded in `lib/backend-release.json`, with `patches/argon.patch` applied. The builder overrides the backend's displayed version with the release version. Six binaries are pinned by SHA-256 in the same JSON file. The build does not include the developer's uncommitted backend sources, local data or credentials.

For a new backend release:

1. Choose a new backend version and tag in `lib/backend-release.json`. Never replace files under an already published backend tag: older plugins pin those hashes. Update the upstream commit or patch when needed.
2. Run `node scripts/backend-release.mjs --write-pins`. It extracts a clean upstream tree, applies the patch, runs Go tests, cross-compiles all six targets and writes the resulting pins. It uses a local `backend-source` Git object database if available; otherwise it fetches the pinned public commit in a temporary directory.
3. Run `npm test` and `node scripts/backend-smoke.mjs`. The smoke test uses a temporary data directory, checks the actual executable's version and hash, starts it on a spare loopback port, checks authentication and model discovery, and verifies reuse. It uses no Google account and takes the tokenizer's offline fallback.
4. Commit the release metadata, installer changes, tests and documentation. Run the **Verify backend release** GitHub Actions workflow at that commit. It rebuilds on native macOS, Linux and Windows runners for both architectures, compares the pinned hashes, and runs the installation/startup smoke test. Wait for all jobs to pass.
5. Create a private draft under the pinned backend tag. Attach all six binaries, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, `build.json`, the patched source archive and `LICENSE-UPSTREAM` from `backend-build/release`. If local binary uploads are unreliable, run **Upload verified backend release** with the successful verification run ID: it downloads the six CI artifacts, checks every committed hash, and uploads missing executables to the draft. Existing assets must match exactly; published releases cannot be modified by this workflow. Include the upstream commit and patch SHA-256 in the release notes, then publish the complete draft. Keep backend-only releases from replacing the plugin release as GitHub's latest release.
6. Verify public asset downloads against the committed pins. Run `node scripts/backend-smoke.mjs --download` to test the actual default download URL on the host platform.
7. Bump and publish the plugin package only after the backend assets are publicly available. Inspect `npm pack --dry-run`; the npm package contains release metadata and patch/build scripts, but no executables, local databases or credentials. Attach the exact published npm tarball to the plugin's GitHub release as well.

Reproduce a release without changing its pins:

```bash
npm run backend:release:build
```

Build just the host target and compare its hash:

```bash
node scripts/backend-release.mjs --target=host --verify
```

The metadata records `CGO_ENABLED=0`, the exact Go toolchain, upstream commit, patch hash and build flags. The binary hashes are reproducible; the source archive is supplied for inspection and is not promised to have a reproducible gzip timestamp. The source archive includes upstream's license, and `LICENSE-UPSTREAM` is also supplied as a separate asset.

Existing running processes are left alone to avoid interrupting requests. Once an old official backend is stopped, automatic startup installs the optimized build while preserving configuration, secrets and the database. A download or checksum failure keeps the old file and never starts an unverified replacement.

New cookie imports require the running backend to advertise `capabilities.account_proxy_binding: true` at `/`. The plugin checks this before changing the proxy pool and again before submitting a cookie, so a reused older or upstream backend cannot silently ignore `proxy_id`. Unsupported builds receive instructions to stop the old process and run the installed plugin's CLI with `install --data-dir=<path>`. This explicitly selects the optimized channel, including for previous upstream or custom-build installations. The check does not interrupt existing conversations. Release smoke verifies the capability and actual proxy selection; version strings alone do not establish support.

An explicit `npm run backend:install:upstream` installs the pinned upstream v4.30.0 and persists `upstream` in `backend-channel.json`. Automatic startup respects that choice. `npm run backend:install` returns to the optimized channel. Stop a running backend before replacing it, particularly on Windows. Explicit local Argon builds remain trusted through their existing build manifest.

# AI Studio 本地后端与历史构建

当前插件（0.14.0 起）已默认接入官方上游发行版，历史托管构建清单仅保留作兼容与复现参考。

默认接入流程为：安装插件 → 登录 Google AI Studio → 自动下载并启动官方后端 → 添加 Google 账号 → 回到连接页确认。安装和后续自动更新均跟随 [Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API/releases) 最新稳定版。运行时不依赖 `lib/studio-release.json`，插件发布无需先发布定制 AI Studio 安装包。

## 官方安装与版本管理

`lib/studio-upstream.mjs` 从 GitHub Releases API 解析 latest，或 `studio:install -- --version <tag>` 指定的标签；只选择 macOS / Linux x64、arm64 和 Windows x64 对应的官方归档。安装器要求官方仓库的下载 URL 和有效的 `sha256:` digest，校验归档后解压；元数据缺失、哈希不符或不安全归档会中止，保留原程序。发布信息查询和下载均使用已有代理设置。`--archive` 可复用本地官方包，但仍需查询所选版本的官方校验值。CI 通过 `AI_STUDIO_GITHUB_TOKEN` 提供 GitHub 的短期只读凭据，减少共享 runner 的匿名 API 限额影响；它仅用于发布元数据查询，经 curl 标准输入传递，不写入配置、不用于安装包下载认证，也不传给后端。普通用户无需设置该变量。

默认程序保存在数据目录的 `package/aistudio2api`；Windows 官方包属于桌面版，会自行切换工作目录，因此默认把 `aistudio2api.exe` 放在数据目录根部，与 `.env` 和 `runtime/` 相邻。启动先复用已有程序，缺失时下载。`install-manifest.json` 记录来源与完整性校验，不强制恢复历史文件或版本。

`lib/studio-updates.mjs` 在 Magpie 运行期间后台检查官方稳定版：启动一秒后首次尝试，每分钟寻找空闲窗口；成功检查缓存一小时，联网／下载失败后等待 15 分钟重试。只有可解析、较新的稳定版本可以自动安装，未知开发版本和已安装的较新版本不被降级。默认目录自动启用；`studio:updates auto|manual` 修改策略，`studio:install -- --version <tag>` 切到手动更新。高级自备路径和独立服务不参加自动更新。

生成请求的占用持续到响应体读完、取消或中止，流式响应不会在收到响应头后提前释放；登录占用覆盖整个连接回调。进程启动时间和随机标识支持跨宿主协调，失效记录只删除对应的独立文件，避免清理旧锁时误删新锁。更新还检查后台生成计数、忙碌账号、未结束登录任务、浏览器下载／准备和官方更新器状态；能力缺失或状态未知时暂缓。

下载、官方 SHA-256 校验和解压先在暂存目录完成，原服务继续可用。替换前取得维护锁，再检查任务、策略和现有程序哈希；仅在进程身份确认并退出后交换程序，启动新版本并核对报告的版本。失败时尝试恢复并启动旧程序，该发行包随后不再反复触发重启；重新启用自动更新可明确重试。账号、`.env`、配置、端口和凭据原样保留。回滚覆盖程序文件和安装记录，不撤销上游自身的数据迁移。

已有无 `backend` 字段的配置沿用默认目录。具备所需管理接口的旧 `-magpie` 构建也可由插件自动替换为较新的官方包，无需调用其受限的在线更新接口。显式安装、程序切换、启动与自动更新共享生命周期锁；HTTP 暂时关闭但旧进程仍存活时，阻止重复启动或覆盖。需要手动切换时仍可停止服务后执行 `studio:install`。

本地连接所需的监听地址、绝对账号目录 `AISTUDIO_AUTH_STATES`、API key、管理员认证和自动启动由插件维护。新建 `config.json` 标记 `defaultsPolicy: upstream`，其余设置采用官方默认值。已有配置没有该标记时，只为缺失项写入旧默认值，成功后标记 `legacy-migrated`：搜索模型别名关闭，`PER_ACCOUNT_CONCURRENCY`、`WARM_WORKER_LIMIT`、`MAX_ACTIVE_WORKERS`、`WARM_STARTUP_CONCURRENCY` 均为 1，路由为 `fill-first`，请求期限为 30 分钟；同时保留旧版关闭备用请求、非流式保活及生成后端的默认行为。所有显式值及合法未知键保留。迁移只执行一次，避免官方 Save 省略其默认值后又被插件反复补写。

新安装目前采用官方 SpiderMonkey 生成默认值；如果以后选用的版本改变 `WAA_BACKEND` 默认值，生成也可能需要 Camoufox 等浏览器依赖。并发和路由同样跟随所选版本，v0.3.7 为每账号并发 2、预热 10／最大 20 个 Worker 和 round-robin。宿主同名配置变量仍被隔离；`.env` 首行注释避免官方后端误触旧版完整文件迁移。

## 插件账号管理接入

默认官方包没有 `magpie_signin` 能力，`lib/studio-connect.mjs` 会进入 `lib/studio-connect-legacy.mjs`：用户打开已认证的官方管理页添加账号，再回到连接页选择并确认。过期账号会明确提示找到原账号并点击「重新登录」，确认仍限定为原账号。页面在断线时停用确认按钮，恢复后清除临时错误；弹窗拦截重试成功后清除旧提示，迟到响应不会覆盖取消结果。推荐入口改名为「添加账号并连接（推荐）」，直接说明添加后回程确认。凭据由插件生成并接入管理会话，无需填写 URL、API key 或管理员密码；额度卡片不展示管理员信息、凭据位置或程序路径。Magpie 宿主仍有 10 分钟等待上限，官方管理页的后台准备和登录不受该连接超时影响；新增 `studio:prepare-browser` 可在登录前独立准备 Camoufox，不再占用登录计时。原有 `metadata.managed: true` 表示本地生命周期与账号接入，独立于后端版本；已有单账号、账号组卡片和模型功能继续可用。

下面保留任务关联补丁的技术说明。对提供 `magpie_signin: 1` 的旧版或自定义后端，插件继续使用自动完成流程；这不是默认官方安装的前置条件。

提供任务关联能力时，`lib/studio-connect.mjs` 在准备本地服务后，同一标签页自动进入该后端的账号导入／登录界面。上游登录模式展示 Chrome 导入、Cookie 导入、调试浏览器会话导入和浏览器登录，隐藏远程配对。专用重登入口显示加载、错误或账号缺失状态，使用隔离浏览器重新登录。v0.3.5 也支持通过添加账号入口导入同一账号来更新认证状态；`studio-0.3.5-signin-reauth.patch` 修正此前不支持覆盖导入的提示。单个账号成功后直接保存原有 `managed: true` 的 `ai-studio` 登录；批量导入成功后保存 `metadata.accounts` 和带账号集合摘要的 `metadata.email`，使不同分组不会互相覆盖；同组以不同顺序重试保持相同标识。额度卡片的账号和冷却记录都按本次账号组过滤。此元数据不改变后端的全局选号、API key 绑定或模型绑定规则。模型、图片和用量继续走原插件，不调用 `magpie://import` 创建其他供应商。

`patches/studio-0.3.4-magpie-signin.patch` 给管理页增加由 URL fragment 开启的登录模式，并给账号任务增加 `client_id`、成功条目的规范 `account_id` 和 `GET /api/accounts/tasks` 的 `magpie_signin: 1` 能力标识。每次登录使用独立随机标识；只有当前页面提交的完整成功任务能完成认证。插件从后台任务取得账号 ID，再重新读取账号列表校验。已有账号、其他窗口任务、失败或部分失败任务均不会自动完成当前登录。部分失败可只重试失败账号：插件按本次标识累积每个已成功条目的账号 ID，最终成功时合并、去重并重新校验。登录模式暂不提供关闭失败任务的按钮，避免插件观察前删除成功条目；已观察到的成功条目即使之后从任务列表移除也会保留。刷新页面保留登录标识；关闭浏览器后，插件仍能跟踪已启动任务。

管理会话通过本机 HTTP 响应的 `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api` Cookie 交给浏览器。两个服务均限定为 `http://127.0.0.1`；Cookie 按主机共享，不按端口隔离。临时页使用随机路径、严格 Host / 写操作 Origin 检查和 CSP，状态接口不返回 API key、管理密码或 Google Cookie。上游 fragment 仅含关联标识、本机回程地址、截止时间及可选目标账号；不放凭据。自动流程取消或超时只取消本次标识下仍运行的任务，保留已导入账号。结束后不再发放管理会话，两分钟后关闭临时服务，并清理本次标识下的成功、失败及未结束任务记录。回程页的状态请求会等待正在进行的检查或立即检查任务，无需额外等待轮询周期。

**历史构建：** `0.3.5-magpie.1` 和候选 `0.3.7-magpie.1` 均含自动登录补丁。插件按能力标识选择流程，官方或其他构建缺少该能力时手动确认账号。

候选构建配置位于 `scripts/studio-signin-candidate.json`，空的 `binaries` 条目表示尚无发行哈希，不是可安装的发行清单。普通本机构建可验证补丁和 UI（不会改动当前 pin）：

```sh
node scripts/studio-release.mjs --manifest=scripts/studio-signin-candidate.json --target=host
```

正式五平台构建使用 `studio.yml` 的 `write_pins=true` 和 `signin_candidate=true`，从固定工具链生成 candidate artifacts。收集阶段会验证所有构建记录的上游、补丁哈希和工具链，再产生完整 `candidate-pins`。如需单独发布定制构建，可更新其历史清单并执行五平台验证；普通插件发布无需此步骤。也可用 `scripts/studio-pins.mjs --manifest=<candidate.json> <build-record.json>...` 合并本地候选记录；缺平台或输入不一致会拒绝。不要把本机 beta Xcode 的验证构建哈希写入正式 pin。

测试覆盖当前任务隔离、批量导入、部分失败重试、完成时重新校验、重新登录身份限制、来源检查、旧后端回退、取消和超时；上游补丁另含任务关联、前端回程地址、窄视口导航、路由锁定及重登状态渲染测试。Windows CI 运行全部 `studio*.test.mjs`，候选配置随 npm 包提供。构建脚本同时运行这些测试、上游 Go 测试、前端 lint 和类型检查。真实 Google 登录和 Windows Chrome 导入仍需带账号验证。

## 高级程序路径与验收

「指定 AIStudio2API 程序路径（高级）」和 `studio:use -- <executable>` 共用 `useStudioBinary()`，保存 `backend: { "mode": "user", "binaryPath": "/absolute/path/to/aistudio2api" }`。程序须位于插件和 AI Studio 数据目录之外。插件不复制或下载替换该文件，缺失时直接报错。`studio:use-default` 在停止服务后回到默认目录，保留原自备程序；默认目录的已有程序继续复用。

两种启动模式均传入绝对账号目录环境变量和 `-auth=...` 标记；自备程序的进程归属同时核对该标记和可执行文件，防止误停共用程序的其他实例。检测保留 true／false／unknown 三种结果，无法确认存活进程身份时保留 PID、阻止启动与替换且不发送信号。启动记录另存进程启动时间、程序路径和账号目录，只在 PID 与这些记录仍相符时恢复暂时不可读的命令行归属。macOS 扫描同时读取 comm 和完整启动命令，识别 CLI 更新器的隐藏旧文件及 deleted 标记。两种本地路径均保留认证、状态结构和 API key 检查，不按版本字符串判断服务归属。

`cleanStudio()` 和卸载清理会停止默认目录的实例、删除下载资产并保留账号与配置；自备路径则跳过整个 AI Studio 数据目录及运行进程，显式 `studio:stop` 仍可用。独立运行的服务继续使用 URL + API key 接入。

以下常规验收使用临时数据目录与无 Cookie 的虚构停用／服务受限账号记录，不使用真实 Google 账号、不向 Google 发起生成请求，也不执行在线更新。它们验证真实插件回调、管理会话交接、卡片、停止后重连和取消保留账号，并在副本运行时执行官方更新器相同的 rename／replace／unlink 文件操作，注入 HTTP 拒绝以确定性覆盖重启窗口；结束后停止实例并清理临时数据。服务受限记录无法启动生成服务，对应的启动失败日志是预期结果：

```sh
# 验证普通首次接入：查询官方最新稳定版、下载校验、启动、账号连接页和重启。
```

## 复现构建

维护者需要 Git、tar、curl、Node.js 26.8.2、Go 1.27.1，以及 `lib/studio-release.json` 的 `toolchains` 固定的 C/C++ 工具链。SQLite 需要 C、SpiderMonkey 需要 C++，工具链因此也是 pin 的一部分：

| 目标 | 工具链 | 跨机器字节一致 |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x64/arm64 | Zig `toolchains.zig`（`zig cc` / `zig c++`），musl 静态链接，不依赖构建机器的 glibc | 是：Zig 是自带 libc 的交叉编译器，任何主机产物相同 |
| Windows x64 | llvm-mingw `toolchains.llvmMingw`（Clang + LLD + UCRT），静态链接，PE 时间戳为 0 | 是：同上；构建脚本自动下载并按 SHA-256 校验。Windows 的库（含 C++ 运行库）取自 Linux x64 归档，见下 |
| macOS arm64/x64 | Xcode `toolchains.xcode`，最低目标 macOS 13（与 Go 1.27 一致），只能在 macOS 上构建 | 仅在同一 Xcode 下：Apple 链接器和 SDK 随 Xcode 变化 |

- Zig 默认从 PATH 查找，也可用 `STUDIO_ZIG=/absolute/path/to/zig` 指定。
- llvm-mingw 首次使用时下载到 `studio-build/toolchains/`（macOS、Linux x64、Windows x64 主机各有固定的归档及 SHA-256），之后复用。`STUDIO_MINGW_CC` 可指定其他 `x86_64-w64-mingw32-clang`（C++ 编译器取同目录的 `clang++`），但 `--verify` / `--write-pins` 要求其版本与 pin 一致。
- llvm-mingw 的 Linux 与 Windows 归档里 Windows 目标库逐字节相同，macOS 归档里的是另行构建的，其中 C++ 运行库（libc++abi）会把各自的构建路径写进可执行文件。因此在 macOS 上构建 Windows 时，链接 Linux x64 归档（同样固定 SHA-256）里的目标库；各主机都以一个 `-L` 指明目标库目录，因为 cgo 会把每个链接参数写成生成代码的一行，参数个数不同会改变可执行文件里的行号表。
- SpiderMonkey 静态库同样在首次使用时按目标下载到 `studio-build/toolchains/` 并校验 SHA-256，之后复用。
- Linux（musl）的 SpiderMonkey 静态库带有 mozglue 的环境变量拦截函数（`libjs_static.a` 的 `Unified_cpp_mozglue_interposers0.o`）：除 `getenv` 外，`setenv` 等都经 `dlsym(RTLD_NEXT)` 找 C 库原函数，静态链接的程序找不到，便有意崩溃（`MOZ_CRASH`）；Go 的 `os.Setenv` 在 cgo 程序里正走这条路。构建脚本校验下载后用 `zig ar` 删除这个目标文件，改用 musl 自己的函数；找不到该文件时报错，提示核对新版 SpiderMonkey。上游测试只在动态链接的 glibc 库（`linux-amd64-gnu`）上运行，不会遇到这个问题。
- Xcode 用 `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode_<版本>.app/Contents/Developer` 选择，不需要改系统默认。不要用 beta 版 Xcode 制作发布包。
- 所有目标都以 `-trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags=-buildid=` 编译：Go 默认的 build ID 会哈希 C 编译器路径等构建输入，导致不同机器上内容相同的程序哈希不同。
- Windows 使用 Git Bash 执行命令，安装包运行和解压使用 Windows 自带 PowerShell。最终用户不需要构建工具。

`--verify` 和 `--write-pins` 会在开始构建前检查每个目标的工具链是否与 pin 一致，不一致时几秒内报错并说明需要的版本；不带这两个参数的普通构建只给出警告。

```bash
# 构建所有五个平台并核对现有 pin（macOS 目标需要固定的 Xcode）。
npm run studio:release:build

# 只构建当前平台，或用逗号指定多个目标（Linux/Windows 目标不要求固定的 Xcode）。
node scripts/studio-release.mjs --target=host --verify
node scripts/studio-release.mjs --target=linux-x64,linux-arm64,win32-x64 --verify

# 可复用本地仓库；始终导出固定 commit，再应用清单中的补丁，不使用工作区修改。
node scripts/studio-release.mjs --source=/path/to/AIStudio2API --verify
```

输出在 `studio-build/release/`，不进入 npm 包。包含安装包、构建记录、SHA256SUMS 和上游许可证。构建记录包含固定工具链、实际编译器版本及补丁 SHA-256；`--verify` 失败时也会写入，便于对比差异。安装包固定文件顺序、权限与时间。前端 `.gz` 资源通过 `scripts/studio-regzip.go` 重新压缩，消除 Node zlib 跨平台差异。

## 生成 pin

正式 pin 由 CI 生成，因为 macOS 产物只能在固定的 Xcode 下复现，而 GitHub runner 上有固定版本的 Xcode。修改上游 commit、补丁或工具链后：

1. 审查源码和补丁，更新 `lib/studio-release.json` 的版本、上游及 `toolchains`，提交并推送。
2. 手动运行 **Verify managed AI Studio release** 并勾选 `write_pins`（候选模式）：

   ```bash
   gh workflow run studio.yml --ref <分支> -f write_pins=true
   ```

   每个 runner 构建、测试、记录自己平台的哈希；`Collect candidate pins` 作业用 `scripts/studio-pins.mjs` 校验所有构建记录来自同一源码、补丁和工具链，再把五个平台合并成 `candidate-pins` 产物，并在作业摘要中给出 diff。
3. 下载产物覆盖清单后提交（`gh run download` 不覆盖已有文件，所以先下载到临时目录）：

   ```bash
   dir="$(mktemp -d)" && gh run download <run-id> --name candidate-pins --dir "$dir" \
     && cp "$dir/studio-release.json" lib/studio-release.json
   ```

4. 推送后，PR 上的验证会在全新 runner 上重新构建并严格比对。这一步证明 pin 可以复现，而不只是记录了一次构建结果。

Linux 和 Windows 的 pin 也可以在本机生成（`--target=linux-x64,linux-arm64,win32-x64 --write-pins`），结果应与 CI 相同。不同来源的 pin 不一致说明工具链没有真正固定，应查明原因，不要直接覆盖。候选模式的产物以 `candidate-` 开头，`publish-studio.yml` 只接受 `studio-` 开头的验证产物，因此候选构建不会被上传到 release。
